% A well-typeset source PDF, cropped to its TeX box. Only this source creation
% knows LaTeX: the migration job receives PDF bytes and geometric measurements.
\documentclass[fontset=fandol,zihao=-4]{ctexart}
\usepackage{unicode-math}
\setmathfont{latinmodern-math.otf}
\newsavebox{\sourceformula}
\newwrite\measurements
\newdimen\totalheight
\begin{document}
\sbox{\sourceformula}{$\frac{x+1}{y}$}
\totalheight=\dimexpr\ht\sourceformula+\dp\sourceformula\relax
\immediate\openout\measurements=source-slots.csv
\immediate\write\measurements{formula-1,\the\wd\sourceformula,\the\ht\sourceformula,\the\dp\sourceformula}
\immediate\closeout\measurements
\hoffset=-1in
\voffset=-1in
\shipout\vbox{\offinterlineskip\hbox{%
\special{papersize=\the\wd\sourceformula,\the\totalheight}%
\usebox{\sourceformula}}}
\end{document}
